# Feature glossary (CICIDS2017, 68 features)

*Generated by `tools/feature_glossary.py` from the training split; do not edit by hand.*

**Initiator** = the side that opened the conversation (for an attack: the attacker).
**Responder** = the other side (the victim's server). In the names, `Fwd` means sent by the
initiator and `Bwd` sent by the responder. IAT = inter-arrival time, the gap between two packets.

The *proposed group* follows the name rules in step C1 (Free = the attacker can raise it cheaply,
Costly = with effort, Fixed = cannot change). Step C1 builds the real groups in code.

## Twin groups (|correlation| > 0.95 on the training set)

Features in one group carry almost the same information. Removing one of them alone tells
you little, because its twins still carry the signal (lab sections 3.6, E2 and F1).

| Group | Members | Proposed groups of the members |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Flow Duration, Fwd IAT Total | Free |
| 2 | Total Fwd Packets, Total Backward Packets, Total Length of Bwd Packets, Subflow Fwd Packets, Subflow Bwd Packets, Subflow Bwd Bytes, act_data_pkt_fwd | Costly, Fixed (**mixed**: the attacker controls only part of it) |
| 3 | Total Length of Fwd Packets, Subflow Fwd Bytes | Costly |
| 4 | Fwd Packet Length Max, Fwd Packet Length Std | Free |
| 5 | Fwd Packet Length Mean, Avg Fwd Segment Size | Free |
| 6 | Bwd Packet Length Max, Bwd Packet Length Mean, Bwd Packet Length Std, Avg Bwd Segment Size | Fixed |
| 7 | Flow Packets/s, Fwd Packets/s | Fixed |
| 8 | Flow IAT Max, Fwd IAT Max, Idle Mean, Idle Max, Idle Min | Free |
| 9 | Fwd PSH Flags, SYN Flag Count | Fixed |
| 10 | Fwd URG Flags, CWE Flag Count | Fixed |
| 11 | Fwd Header Length, Bwd Header Length, min_seg_size_forward | Fixed, Free (**mixed**: the attacker controls only part of it) |
| 12 | Max Packet Length, Packet Length Std | Fixed |
| 13 | Packet Length Mean, Average Packet Size | Fixed |
| 14 | RST Flag Count, ECE Flag Count | Fixed |
